# openssl — 2012 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 8 openssl CVEs of 2012 are in `data/cve/vendors/openssl/2012.jsonl`.

### CVE-2012-2110
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2012-04-19 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 18756: OpenSSL - ASN1 BIO Memory Corruption (dos/multiple, 2012-04-19, verified=1)

The asn1_d2i_read_bio function in crypto/asn1/a_d2i_fp.c in OpenSSL before 0.9.8v, 1.0.0 before 1.0.0i, and 1.0.1 before 1.0.1a does not properly interpret integer data, which allows remote attackers to conduct buffer overflow attacks, and cause a denial of service (memory corruption) or possibly have unspecified other impact, via crafted DER data, as demonstrated by an X.509 certificate or an RSA public key.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

### CVE-2012-2131
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2012-04-24 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 18756: OpenSSL - ASN1 BIO Memory Corruption (dos/multiple, 2012-04-19, verified=1)

Multiple integer signedness errors in crypto/buffer/buffer.c in OpenSSL 0.9.8v allow remote attackers to conduct buffer overflow attacks, and cause a denial of service (memory corruption) or possibly have unspecified other impact, via crafted DER data, as demonstrated by an X.509 certificate or an RSA public key.  NOTE: this vulnerability exists because of an incomplete fix for CVE-2012-2110.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a
